items: [ All-in-1 Design for Efficiency and Convenience ] This multi-functional kitchen gadget is designed to streamline your meal prep. SpaceHacks vegetable chopper includes 7 blades, 2 cleaning tools, 1 egg separator, 1 hand protector and a drainable food container for daily chopping, slicing, shredding, and mincing needs. Save time and space by using the versatile mandoline that does it all, making it an essential addition to home cook's arsenal

[ Easy to Clean ] The vegetable chopper comes with a cleaning brush and scraper to easily remove residue from the blades and container. Simply rinse containers and used choppers under a stream of water after meal preparation. The large and sturdy container features water drainage holes in the side for easy draining and drying. For best results, hand wash and avoid placing in the dishwasher

[ Easy to Store ] The compact design and the 1.7 L large container of SpaceHacks vegetable chopper make it easy to store all the blades and accessories neatly, keeping your kitchen organized and clutter-free

[ Premium Stainless Blades for Perfect Cuts Every Time ] The SpaceHacks vegetable chopper comes equipped with 7 interchangeable premium stainless steel blades, offering a wide range of cutting options. From dicing and slicing to julienning and grating, this chopper handles it all. Whether you're preparing onions, cucumbers, or any other vegetables, achieve consistent, professional-grade cuts effortlessly. Tip: The blades are very sharp. Keep fingers clear of the blades at all time

[ Safety First with Finger Guard and Non-Slip Base ] Safety is a top priority, which is why the SpaceHacks food chopper includes a protective finger guard to keep your hands away from the sharp blades. The non-slip base ensures stability during use, preventing accidents and providing a secure grip on any surface. Prepare meals with confidence and peace of mind

[ Ideal for Daily Use & Holiday Meals ] Whether you're preparing a quick weekend meal or a holiday gathering, the SpaceHacks 12-in-1 veggie chopper is up to the task. Its long-lasting construction and versatile design make it a reliable choice for daily cooking and special occasions. Make meal prep a breeze and impress your guests with the perfect ingredients
